paragraphs: A Jaguar AJ300D engine rebuild starts from £3,600, regardless of which of the six models it's fitted to — the price tier is set by the engine, not the badge on the boot. A full replacement engine and fitting service is also available.
Exact pricing depends on the condition of your existing engine and the parts required — submit your registration for a fixed-price quote within 30 minutes.

cards.title: Rebuilding Your
cards.body: Most engine suppliers sell you a used engine of unknown history and hope it matches. We rebuild the engine your Jaguar already has instead — strip it down, pressure-test it, and replace every worn or damaged component with updated OEM parts. You get a near-new engine with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty, without the compatibility risk of an unknown used unit. This is the option most AJ300D owners choose.

cards.title: Replacement
cards.body: If your existing engine is beyond economical repair, we also offer full engine replacement and fitting — sourced and fitted by our team, with the same 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

cards.title: Used
cards.body: In some cases, a matched low-mileage used engine is the right call — particularly if you need your car back on the road quickly and your existing engine's damage is extensive. We can source and fit these too, though most owners who ask about used engines end up choosing a rebuild once they understand the compatibility risk a used unit carries.

options.body: "Reconditioned" is the term many owners search for when they mean the same thing as a rebuild — a full strip-down, inspection, and replacement of worn parts rather than a straight swap. If that's what you're after, our rebuild service is exactly that.
"Refurbished" often describes the same process from a different angle — restoring your existing engine to full working condition rather than replacing it outright. Our rebuild covers this.

Some owners specifically search for a "remanufactured" engine, expecting a unit rebuilt to original specification with updated components. That's consistent with what our rebuild service delivers, regardless of which of the six AJ300D-equipped models you drive.

faqLeft.q: What is the Jaguar AJ300D engine?
faqLeft.a: The AJ300D is Jaguar's 2.1-litre turbocharged four-cylinder diesel engine, in production from 2008 to 2020. It's fitted across 9 different Jaguar models, from the AJ300D to the Sprinter.

faqLeft.q: Which Jaguar models use the AJ300D?
faqLeft.a: The AJ300D is fitted exclusively to the F-Pace D300 (X761, 2019–present).

faqLeft.q: Does the AJ300D differ between Jaguar models?
faqLeft.a: Yes. The specific ancillaries, mounting, and turbo configuration differ by application, even though the base engine code is the same. We match by registration/VIN before confirming any rebuild or replacement.

faqLeft.q: Is an AJ300D from one Jaguar model compatible with another?
faqLeft.a: Not automatically. An AJ300D from a AJ300D isn't a drop-in match for an AJ300D from a Sprinter — ancillaries, mounting, and turbo configuration all differ. We always confirm compatibility by registration/VIN.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Jaguar AJ300D engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,200, regardless of which model it's fitted to. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.
Yes. We work on AJ300D rebuilds across every model it's fitted to, replacing worn components as standard.

faqLeft.q: What are the common AJ300D issues?
faqLeft.a: The AJ300D has documented issues including timing chain tensioner seal leaks (an oil fire risk), rear-mounted timing chain stretch requiring gearbox removal, piezo injector faults, and EGR valve clogging. We inspect all these areas thoroughly during every strip-down.

faqRight.q: Do you work on twin-turbo AJ300D applications?
faqRight.a: Yes. Twin-turbo AJ300D variants (C 250 CDI, E 250 CDI, Sprinter 316 CDI, Vito 113 CDI) are within our workshop capability, with the additional turbocharger components accounted for during inspection.

faqRight.q: Can you rebuild an AJ300D from a Sprinter?
faqRight.a: Yes. The AJ300D in the Sprinter (W906, NCV3 generation) is one of our commercial vehicle applications — we work on 313 CDI and 316 CDI variants.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Jaguar AJ300D engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Jaguar if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an AJ300D engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most AJ300D owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history — a particular concern given how many different AJ300D applications exist across the Jaguar range — and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.
